from __future__ import annotations

import pytest

from llm_router._internal.capabilities.content import normalize_content

pytestmark = pytest.mark.verification_kind("unit")


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_MULTIMODAL_CONTENT_NORMALIZATION[revision==2]")
def test_empty_text_part_is_preserved_in_caller_order() -> None:
    value = ["", "caption"]

    message = normalize_content(value)

    assert len(message.parts) == 2
    assert [part.kind for part in message.parts] == ["text", "text"]
    assert [part.text for part in message.parts] == ["", "caption"]


@pytest.mark.verifies("REQ_MULTIMODAL_CONTENT_NORMALIZATION[revision==2]")
def test_none_part_is_rejected_locally() -> None:
    value = ["caption", None]

    with pytest.raises((TypeError, ValueError), match=r"."):
        normalize_content(value)
